items.originalTitle: Red Bull F1 boss Laurent Mekies hits back at Christian Horner's "lost its mojo" claim
items.summaryEn: Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies has dismissed Christian Horner's claim that the team has "lost its mojo" since his departure.
detailZh: 红牛F1车队负责人洛朗·梅基斯回击克里斯蒂安·霍纳“失去魔力”的说法
红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯驳斥了克里斯蒂安·霍纳关于车队“失去魔力”的说法
洛朗·梅基斯，红牛车队领队
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
红牛车队首席执行官兼领队洛朗·梅基斯驳斥了克里斯蒂安·霍纳的说法，即这支位于米尔顿凯恩斯的车队自他离任以来已经“失去了魔力”，并坚称正是车队的精神推动了一次“非常了不起”的逆转。
霍纳在执掌车队二十年后于2025年7月离开，他一直在宣传自己的回忆录《Drive》，该书于上周出版。在接受《泰晤士报》采访时，这位英国人声称，自他离开后，车队已经“失去了魔力、失去了存在感、失去了氛围”。
在周五于墨西哥城举行的领队新闻发布会上被问及这些言论时，梅基斯表示：“听着，首先，克里斯蒂安有权发表自己的看法。他显然在这支车队度过了很长时间，我尊重他的观点。
“我们对车队氛围的感受显然截然不同。过去几个月里我们一直享有的一个强项，就是那种不可思议的团队精神，它让我们从一个客观上非常艰难的时刻中走了出来。
"当你赢得比赛时，保持积极的精神总是容易的；但当你面临压力时，团队成员之间仍能保持同样的战斗精神和团结，那就是另一回事了。今年上半年我们确实面临了挑战，无论是底盘方面还是动力单元方面。
"团队团结一致的方式，团队让米尔顿凯恩斯部门全力以赴试图反击的方式，以及他们做到这一点的方式，这本身就是一件极具挑战性的事情，从我们任何一位团队成员到车手们直言不讳的评论都是如此。这就是红牛精神，这也正是我们觉得需要去比赛的方式。
"伙计们得到了他们应得的回报，因为他们所实现的逆转非常了不起，但最终我们很清楚，我们的成败取决于成绩。
"目标不是赢一两场比赛；目标是重返世界冠军，直到我们达到那里之前，没有人会觉得我们取得了任何成就。"
红牛目前位列车队积分榜第三，与第四名迈凯伦同分。
detailEn: Red Bull F1 boss Laurent Mekies hits back at Christian Horner's "lost its mojo" claim
Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies has dismissed Christian Horner's claim that the team has "lost its mojo"
Laurent Mekies, Red Bull Racing Team Principal
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Red Bull Racing CEO and team principal Laurent Mekies has rejected Christian Horner's claim that the Milton Keynes outfit has "lost its mojo" since his exit, insisting its spirit has driven a "very remarkable" turnaround.

Horner, who left the team in July 2025 after two decades in charge, has been promoting his memoir Drive, which was published last week. During an interview with The Times, the Briton claimed the team had "lost its mojo, its presence, its vibe" since he left.

Asked about the comments in Friday's team principals' press conference in Mexico City, Mekies said: "Look, first of all, Christian is entitled to his opinion. He obviously has spent a lot of time in this team and I respect his point of view.

"We certainly feel extremely differently about the vibe in the team. One of the strong points we have been enjoying certainly in the last few months is the incredible team spirit that has allowed us to come back from an objectively very difficult moment.

"It's always one thing to have a positive spirit when you are winning races, it's something else to have that same fighting spirit and unity between the team members when you are put under pressure, and we certainly had a challenging first part of the year, on the chassis side and the PU side.

"The way the team stuck together, the way the team set the Milton Keynes department on fire to try to come back, and the way they have done that, it's such a challenging matter, from any of our team members to the brutally honest comments of our drivers. That's the Red Bull spirit and that's certainly how we feel we need to go racing.
"The guys got the reward they deserved with the turnaround that they have produced, which is very remarkable, but ultimately we are well aware that we live and die with our results.
"The target is not to win one race or two races; the target is to be back to world titles, and until we are there, nobody will feel we have achieved anything."
Red Bull currently sits third in the constructors' standings, level on points with fourth-placed McLaren.

本赛季我也经历过这种情况。人们说无风不起浪，但事实上有些人会编造故事。
在迈阿密发生了什么？据称，我和(贝尔曼的队友)奥康发生了争执。这完全没有事实依据，甚至那些声称他们有内部信息的人，完全是胡说八道。
“这次我又不知道是谁提出了这个六百万欧元的数字。第一次我在Instagram上看到它，或者说是Stu [Morrison, 哈斯公关官]转发给我的，我当时就想着，'哦，又一个很好的……有人出来搅局了'。
天空体育的克雷格·斯莱特会见拉斐尔·卡马拉，埃斯蒂班·奥康的哈斯车队2027年的替代者
这些人显然不是想帮助任何事情，对吧？现在的人们不检查来源真是太令人惊讶了。
所以，好吧，我想吸引更多的点击量，我想吸引更多的点赞，所以他们复制粘贴那些故事，继续传播，然后你还没反应过来，就像有20个人在传播他们认为的事实。这完全是胡说八道。”
虽然小松拒绝透露阻止达成协议的细节，但他坚持说车队"希望与贝尔曼一起成长"。
"我不喜欢深入讨论我们的合同细节，"小松说。"奥利展现出了惊人的潜力。他做出了很多贡献，并且正在为车队成功做出更多贡献。
小松否认哈斯是法拉利的B车队，因为法拉利青训车手卡马拉与贝尔曼签约后，
"我们希望一起成长，我们希望作为团队提升排名，所以首先我们需要一辆有竞争力的赛车。"
"2027年不会是容易的挑战，因为2026年我们犯了一个错误，所以这也将导致2027年也要付出代价。"
我们的重点是真正地最大化所有可控的因素，所以真正地努力推出一款具有竞争力的2027年赛车，然后希望Ollie也能加入驾驶，然后我们再继续前进。
贝尔曼因为通过青训车队加入了法拉利，所以仍然与法拉利保持着联系，并且没有隐瞒他想要在意大利车队获得一个位置的愿望。
然而，他坚持认为，尽管在法拉利——或者F1的其他顶级车队——获得一个位置仍然遥不可及，但他渴望继续在哈斯车队进行他的F1之旅。
在墨西哥的周四，贝尔曼表示：“我认为这非常清楚。我想继续与哈斯合作。这绝对是我的目标。”
在驾驶了艾尔顿·塞纳1985年的Lotus 97T赛车后，贝尔曼情绪激动，这辆赛车是塞纳赢得他首个一级方程式胜利的赛车
“有一些背景工作我们在进行中，但非常明确的是，继续与哈斯合作将是我目标，我们正在这方面最终确定一些事情。”
当被问及延迟的原因时，贝尔曼坚持表示，如果由他决定，到这个时候交易就已经完成了。
“这真的不在我手中，我可以告诉你，”他补充道。
“如果由我来决定，这早就已经宣布了。”
“但我们正在处理一些更大的问题。”

detailEn: Oliver Bearman: Haas boss Ayao Komatsu furiously dismisses reports claiming British driver is demanding £5m annual salary
Watch every Mexico City GP session live on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 9pm on Saturday and the race at 8pm on Sunday
Haas team principal Ayao Komatsu has dismissed speculation suggesting Oliver Bearman will be leaving the team
Haas boss Ayao Komatsu has furiously dismissed reports claiming that contract extension talks with Oliver Bearman are being held up by the British driver demanding a £5m annual salary.
Both Bearman and Komatsu have expressed confidence in recent weeks that a deal will be done to extend the 21-year-old's current contract, which expires at the end of the 2026 season.

With Haas having already announced the signing of Bearman's fellow Ferrari junior Rafael Camara to replace Esteban Ocon next season, the lack of confirmation on his own future has led to speculation over what the issues are that are holding up the deal.
How Antonelli can win world title at Mexico City GP on Sunday

Asked on Friday at the Mexico City Grand Prix about claims that Bearman's financial demands are the main sticking point, Komatsu said: "I have no idea where that comes from.
"I've experienced this sometimes this season as well. People say there's no smoke without fire but really some people will invent a story.

"What happened in Miami? Apparently, I had an argument with (Bearman's team-mate) Esteban Ocon. There's just absolutely zero truth in it and even those people claiming that they had some insider information etc, absolute total nonsense.

"This one again I don't know who smoked up this six-million euros number. The first time I saw it on Instagram, or Stu [Morrison, Haas press officer] forwarded it to me, and I was just like, 'oh another great… somebody has come up and stirred up whatever'.
Sky Sports' Craig Slater meets Rafael Camara, Esteban Ocon's Haas replacement for 2027
"Those people clearly are not trying to help anything right? It's amazing these days that people don't check the source.

"So, ok I want to get some more clicks, I want to get some more likes, so they copy and paste those stories and keep running with it, then before you know it, like 20 people are running the stories that they think it's a truth. It's absolute nonsense."
While Komatsu refused to reveal the details that are preventing an agreement from being reached, he insisted the team "want to grow together" with Bearman.
"I don't like to go into the details of our contract," Komatsu said. "Ollie is showing amazing potential. He contributed a lot and he's contributing a lot to the team's success.
Komatsu denies Haas are a Ferrari B team after Ferrari junior driver Camara signs alongside Bearman
"We want to grow together, we want to move up the grid as a team, so first and foremost we need a competitive car.
"2027 is not going to be the easy challenge because 2026 we made a mistake, so that's paying the price for 2027 as well.
"Our focus is really to maximise everything under control, so really trying to roll out a competitive 2027 car and then hopefully we'll have Ollie driving as well and then take it from there."
Bearman remains attached to Ferrari having come through the team's junior programme, and has made no secret of his desire to earn a seat with the Italian squad.
However, he insists that while a seat at Ferrari - or one of F1's other established top teams - remains out of reach, he is keen to continue his F1 journey with Haas.
Speaking on Thursday in Mexico, Bearman said. "I think it's very clear. I want to continue with Haas. That's definitely my goal.
Bearman was reduced to tears after driving Ayrton Senna's 1985 Lotus 97T, the car Senna drove to his first-ever Formula 1 victory
"There are a few things in the background that we're working on, but it's been very clear that continuing with Haas will be my target, and we're just finalising a few things on that front."
Asked about the delay, Bearman insisted that a deal would have been finalised by this point if it was up to him.
"It's not really in my hands, I can tell you that," he added.
"If it was up to me, it would have already been announced a long time ago.
"But there are a few bigger-picture things that we're working on."

位于米尔顿凯恩斯的新设施将取代位于贝德福德的现有风洞。它曾被称为前红牛车队负责人克里斯蒂安·霍纳的“冷战遗物”，车队非常期待它能带来的成果
它最初计划在2026赛季在线，因此车队粉丝会欣赏这次更新。
“在时间表方面，它还没有准备好，”他在Motorsport.com提问后对媒体说。“它将在下赛季的某个时候上线。是第一季度，还是第二季度，还是第三季度？我们将拭目以待。”
他还补充说，日期将取决于许多因素。
“它将基于我们上线所需的时间以及完成校准工作所需的时间。所以很可能是2027年车型的第二部分，希望是‘28车型的大部分。”
Mekies承认，尽管红牛车队在使用它的情况下取得了成功，但目前他们正在与可能是F1中最古老的气动力风洞合作。
马克斯·维斯塔潘、红牛车队、劳伦特·梅基斯、红牛车队车队总监
“尽管我们使用的风洞在过去几年中最终产生了非凡的结果，但我认为你的评估是正确的，它很可能是赛道上最老的一个。”
红牛车队在2021年至2024年期间，使用贝德福德设施，与马克斯·维斯塔潘一起赢得了四个连续的车手冠军。事实上，红牛车队的2023赛季是锦标赛历史上最统治性的赛季——对于一个古董设备来说，这并不坏。
Mekies预计新的隧道会给车队带来提升，但这不会一蹴而就。
如果你跳到一个最先进的设施，并且车队真的尝试设计和现在生产出一些能让我们在那个领域回到最前面的东西，当然你期望从这里获得竞争优势。
所以，当我们开启一切时，它不会立即出现，但肯定能释放潜力，并为我们在空气动力学部门的才华横溢的人们提供另一种表达想法的方式。
detailEn: Red Bull reveals when its long-awaited new F1 wind tunnel will be operational
Laurent Mekies says the team’s state-of-the-art facility will most likely only help the second half of its 2027 car’s development

Red Bull has been waiting for its new wind tunnel for a long time now, but, ahead of the Mexican Grand Prix, team principal Laurent Mekies has confirmed that it will not come online until some point during the 2027 season.

This new facility in Milton Keynes will replace its current tunnel sat in Bedford. With it once being described by former Red Bull chief Christian Horner as a "Cold War relic", the squad is very much looking forward to enjoying the fruits it will surely bear.
It was originally meant to be online for the 2026 season, so fans of the team will appreciate the update.

“In terms of timeline, it is not ready yet," he told the media after a question from Motorsport.com. "It’s something that will come online sometime during next season. Is it first quarter, is it second quarter, is it third quarter? We’ll see.”
He added that the date will depend on a number of factors.

“It will be based on how much time we need to get it online first and then to complete the calibration work. So most likely for the second part of the 2027 car, and hopefully for most of the ‘28 car.”
Mekies admitted that Red Bull is currently working with what is likely to be the oldest wind tunnel in F1, despite the success the team has enjoyed with it.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Laurent Mekies, Red Bull Racing Team Principal

“As much as the wind tunnel we are using have been ultimately producing extraordinary results in the last few years, I think you are right in your assessment that it is most likely the oldest one on the grid.”

Red Bull won four consecutive drivers’ titles with Max Verstappen between 2021 and 2024 using the Bedford facility. In fact, Red Bull's 2023 campaign was the most dominant in the championship's history - not bad for an antique.
Mekies expects the new tunnel to give the team a boost, but it won't happen overnight.

“If you jump to a state-of-the-art facility, and the team have really tried to design and now produce something that will put us back at the very first place in that area, of course you expect a competitive advantage from there.

“So it’s not going to come up as soon as we switch on everything, but it’s certainly going to unlock potential, and to give the talented people we have in the aero departments another way to express their ideas.”
